Subject: Acme Robotics x NOBE | Student Engineering Project, Spring 2027

Good Morning!

I hope your week has been off to a good start!

My name is Jordan Lee, a Junior studying Mechanical Engineering at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. I am a Project Manager at NOBE (National Organization for Business and Engineering), a student business and engineering organization on campus.

I saw that Acme Robotics recently launched a new version of its gripper. Our engineering team could take one subsystem, such as the finger joint or the wrist mount, and deliver a CAD redesign focused on part count and cost, with 3D-printed prototypes for your team to test.

We propose a 12-week project from January to April, with an option to continue into the fall. All we ask is a short check-in with your team every week or two. Our members get real engineering experience, and you get a dedicated student team working on a problem you care about.

I have also attached a brief overview of NOBE for your reference. Would you be open to a 20-minute call to talk through what a project could look like? I can send a Calendar Invite for whatever time works best.

Looking forward to hearing from you!
